threshold_description: At six retained main sessions, fewer than five unassisted successes on either navigation task or fewer than five correct first answers on any comprehension item triggers review; these are project iteration criteria, not validated standards.
task_order: Odd main IDs: T1,T2,T3,T4; even main IDs: T2,T1,T3,T4. Reset the app before each navigation task.
design: One moderated formative convenience-sample round; no control group, causal impact test or physiological validation. Pilot excluded.
